Mid-cycle Basic→Pro upgrade, then prove the D6 renewal charges $15.00 on the unchanged due date

HTML vs plain-text rendering of the renewal invoice and payment-received emails, and link resolution
Orphan and edge states: product trashed, price edited, customer deleted mid-cycle (exploratory)
EARLY renew from the customer portal: full amount, next date anchored to the original due date, legs replaced
Update the Paddle payment method and prove the next Paddle-driven renewal uses it, plus the missing local update surface

Variable-product variation switch (Starter→Plus) plus on-hold and pending-cancellation switch refusals
Pending cancellation with a required reason and declined offers, then customer reactivation
Calendar overflow on the month flex product: the 31st day is absorbed into the last active segment
Subscriptions list: status tabs, search, gateway filter, columns, pagination, delete guardrails
Grace phase 2: terminal cancellation three days after the hold, with customer and admin cancel emails
Mid-grace recovery: new card in My Account, pay the failed renewal, and prove the next-payment anchor
Customer view of an unpaid renewal invoice and paying it from the portal before the automatic charge leg
Admin-side repeat of the Basic to Pro upgrade and record-for-record diff against SLT-SW-01
Charge a non-zero $7.50 upgrade switch fee on Pro→Enterprise and restore the fee to 0 in-task
Renewal execution after a synced first charge: second charge full on the boundary, third on the grid
Expired, reactivated and auto-downgrade emails, incl. the expiry-suppression negative
Expiring-soon at days_before=7 and card-expiring: two emails nothing can trigger
Negative sweep: cancelled gets no reminders, lifetime gets no renewal mail, expired gets no further mail
LATE renewal on S5: prove the schedule catches up to the cycle grid and that a past computed date queues zero legs
Customer downgrade applies now, and expiry auto-downgrade with its email on the D8 drain day
SLT-TT-00 D8 time-travel pre-flight: snapshot the queue and every non-SLT next-payment date
Subscription detail screen: every field, dates, schedule, related orders, gateway panel
Refund a renewal order: gateway refund, subscription effect, and emails
Capability gating: shop_manager vs editor vs subscriber on every admin surface
End-of-window log sweep, failed-action audit and cycle-to-order reconciliation
